name: ebk
description: EBK (Empower Bank Konnect) — African fintech platform. Empower. Bank. Connect.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ebk/core && npm run build -w @ebk/api && npm run build -w @ebk/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ebk/core && npm run test -w @ebk/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run prepare:deps && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @ebk/core && npm run dev -w @ebk/web
scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @ebk/core && npm run prisma:generate -w @ebk/api
scripts.prepare:deps: npm run build -w @ebk/core && npm run prisma:generate -w @ebk/api
